answer: Random beacon audits stop hoarded identities. A VRF beacon picks 5% of identities each epoch. Picked identities must prove work within 1 epoch. Miss the proof and lose 50 units and 10 reputation points. An umber mark flags missed proofs publicly. A thread of audit history follows each identity. An ember of warning precedes the second miss. Two misses in 6 epochs bar the identity for 8 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities means 50 audits per epoch. A 30% miss rate costs 750 units per epoch plus barred clones. Honest agents prove work once. Clones cannot predict the beacon.
